values: Fix one item at a time. Green means completed; amber means implementation is waiting for verification.
Predictable fallback JWT secrets and credential-encryption key are embedded in server code.
Require strong secrets at startup; never provide runtime fallback values.
Missing secrets in production allow JWT forgery and arbitrary decryption of mail-provider credentials.
Fail production startup if required secrets are absent or invalid.
Required secrets are validated before startup.
compileTemplate validates variables against a hardcoded dictionary.
Extract variable tokens dynamically and validate naming syntax only.
Custom CRM fields are accepted; malformed variable names are rejected.
Dashboard, campaigns, contacts, templates, and identity mostly use static mock data.
Replace mocks with API-backed data; label intentional demo mode.
App pages are directly reachable without an authentication boundary.
Add route protection, Next.js middleware, and session validation.
Next proxy redirects missing sessions; app boundary validates /auth/me.
Log out only navigates to login; it does not revoke or clear credentials.
Call logout endpoint, clear session state/cookies, and redirect.
Refresh tokens are stored in plaintext directly on User.refreshToken.
Store SHA-256 hashed tokens in RefreshToken records with TTL expiry and per-session revocation.
Access token is stored in localStorage, exposing it to XSS theft.
Use secure HttpOnly cookies and CSRF defenses, or a server-side session/BFF.
useEffectEvent is imported from react, causing Dialog and Toast runtime crashes on unsupported React builds.
Use stable callback refs with useEffect.
Dialog Escape handling and Toast timer use latest-callback refs.
No Resend webhook handling for delivered, bounced, opened, clicked, or complained events.
Add verified, idempotent webhook ingestion to update recipients and campaign counters.
Campaigns do not reliably become COMPLETED.
Reconcile terminal recipient states and finish campaigns automatically.
Public unsubscribe link is injected into emails, but the route is not implemented.
Implement and mount a public unsubscribe route with HMAC verification and suppression updates.
API reports healthy even without MongoDB.
Separate liveness/readiness checks; fail production startup if dependencies are unavailable.
Added liveness and MongoDB readiness endpoints; production startup guard added.
UI promises Resend, SMTP, and SES, but sending supports only Resend.
Implement SMTP/SES adapters or narrow UI and documentation to Resend.
Sending uses MongoDB transactions, but supplied Docker Mongo is standalone.
Run Mongo as a replica set or redesign around an idempotent outbox.
CampaignRecipient lacks a compound reconciliation index.
Add index on status and createdAt.
startSend performs a non-atomic status check before starting.
Atomically lock DRAFT to QUEUED and return 409 when no match exists.
Use a transactional outbox and expose a dispatch-pending state.
Reconciliation uses unpaginated sequential N+1 MongoDB and Redis queries.
Paginate, bulk-fetch by campaign, and batch Redis lookups.
shared/enums.ts is orphaned and omitted from root workspaces.
Package @patra/shared under packages/shared and share enums/schemas.
Client is written entirely in untyped JavaScript.
Migrate client to strict TypeScript and consume shared API types.
MailTransport is queried before checking cache, and cache is not invalidated on credential updates.
Check cache first and invalidate it after credential changes.
Test-send endpoint directly calls Resend rather than using IMailTransportAdapter.
Route test sends through getOrBuildTransport and adapter.send.
ImageAsset stores raw image buffers in MongoDB BSON.
Store images in S3-compatible object storage and keep CDN URLs in MongoDB.
SenderIdentity stores redundant transportId that can drift from domain.transportId.
Remove SenderIdentity.transportId and resolve via domainId.transportId.
Publishing a template leaves Template.status as DRAFT.
Atomically set Template.status to PUBLISHED when creating a version.
A route-specific regex bypasses the global body parser limit.
Remove the bypass and configure a suitable global body limit.
Contact import rejects standard multipart/form-data and text/csv uploads.
Accept multipart uploads and standard CSV/Excel MIME types.
Campaign creation does not verify referenced template, sender, and list belong to the organization.
Validate ownership of all referenced resources before creation.
Existing-list imports are not fully idempotent despite accepting a request ID.
Store import jobs/results by organization and request ID.
Root npm test fails because the client has no test script.
Add client tests or explicitly handle the client in the Turbo test pipeline.
Client test command and Turbo test task added.
Server lint lacks an ESLint 9 flat configuration.
Add apps/server/eslint.config and enforce lint in CI.
Flat config added; existing lint violations remain for separate cleanup.
Server tests require Redis but do not provision or stub it.
Start disposable Redis in test setup or use a purpose-built test double.
Testcontainers-based Redis setup added; requires a Docker-capable runner.
Client production build depends on fetching Google Fonts.
Self-host fonts or make network access a declared build prerequisite.
Root README describes obsolete backend and frontend folders.
Rewrite setup and architecture docs for apps/server and apps/client.
Client README is still the default Next.js starter README.
Replace it with client setup, environment, and testing guidance.
Docker uses redis:latest, making builds non-reproducible.
Server Dockerfile assumes an isolated package lock and ignores monorepo dependencies.
Build from repo root and use turbo prune server --docker.
Docker dependency health and restart behavior are incomplete.
Add health checks, restart policies, and operational guidance.
Dashboard presents static demo metrics as current live data.
Show a demo badge or connect metrics to the backend.
Dashboard date and user identity are hard-coded.
Derive them from runtime and authenticated session.
Use one shared calculation and formatting function.
